description.value: Mythos Taverna is a family-owned Greek restaurant that has been a North Shore institution since 1992. It serves homemade recipes made with fresh ingredients alongside signature cocktails in a warm, welcoming atmosphere. Cyclists can dine in or place a takeout order by phone, with delivery also available.
